evals.prompt: Generate a 4:5 campus service-day poster with readable text SERVICE DAY and a warm civic-service feel.
evals.expected_output: The agent rewrites the request as a narrative image prompt with subject, setting, style, composition, lighting, palette, and text constraints before dispatching image generation.
expectations: The prompt is a coherent scene description rather than a comma-separated keyword list.
The prompt specifies the 4:5 aspect ratio before generation.
Readable text is quoted and tied to a physical sign or surface.

evals.prompt: Use refs/character.png to make the same character stand in a rainy neon bookstore at night. Keep her face consistent.
evals.expected_output: The agent chooses the reference-image/edit path, writes a Master Identity Spec, and changes only the scene/style details needed.
expectations: The response defaults to image-to-image/editing because a reference image is provided.
The prompt includes a stable identity block before the scene description.
The prompt asks to preserve identity traits while changing scene and atmosphere.

evals.prompt: This generated product image has a bad hand and wrong background. Fix only those issues and keep everything else.
evals.expected_output: The agent recommends a targeted edit/inpainting-style follow-up instead of regenerating from scratch.
expectations: The response uses a narrow follow-up prompt that changes one main dimension at a time.
The response explicitly preserves composition, product identity, and unaffected details.
The response is honest that hands/anatomy may need iterative local repair rather than a guaranteed prompt-only fix.
